title: Science Theory Rigor & Completion Matrix — 2026-09-11
status: project-wide scientific maturity audit and value-prioritization layer
purpose: Evaluate the major scientific theory families by what would add genuine explanatory, mathematical or empirical value rather than by how many equations, dimensions, famous theories or symbolic correspondences can be added. This record routes future work toward the smallest serious next calculation, dataset, proof or falsification test for each branch.
novelty_scope: This completion architecture and the project-specific recommendations were added on 2026-09-11. The underlying scientific methods are established external mathematics/science unless explicitly marked as project formalisms.
core_rule: A theory becomes more serious when additional structure reduces ambiguity and increases calculability, observability or risk of falsification. Additional terminology or algebra that creates more free interpretation without a new constraint is negative value.
completeness_vector: Q=(P,T,D,E,C,O,F,B,N): provenance, type/domain clarity, dimensional consistency, equation/well-posedness, consistency/symmetry, observable linkage, falsifiability, baseline comparison, novel explanatory/compressive value. Score components separately 0-4; never turn Q into a truth score.

value_classes.A_high_value: There is a clear mathematical/empirical next step that can materially strengthen or reject the model.
value_classes.B_structural_value: The model is useful as mathematics, systems theory or knowledge representation even if no new physical law is established.
value_classes.C_archaeology_value: Primary value is historical recovery/correction; further physical formalization should wait for sources.
value_classes.D_do_not_inflate: More equations would currently be decorative or category-confusing; preserve as symbolic/comparative material.

project_wide_anti_inflation_rules: No master equation should be expanded merely to mention another field of science.
No new force without a source charge, mediator/field, interaction law, range/scale and an unexplained observation it addresses.
No new dimension without a coordinate/state-space definition, metric or operational dimensional estimator and observable consequences.
No quantum claim from correlation alone; specify preparation, observable, dynamics and quantum-sensitive test.
No consciousness biomarker from one post-hoc frequency/exponent/chemical level.
No cross-scale universality from visual resemblance; require common dimensionless statistics or a shared generative law.
No group-theory unification by name accumulation; require representations, breaking and predictions.
No theorem-like invariant unless its domain and preservation mechanism are proved or explicitly assumed.
No equation earns status from complexity: equations must reduce uncertainty about what the model permits and forbids.
cross_corpus_priority_queue.definition_of_added_value: A future science edit adds value if it does at least one of the following: resolves an ambiguity; derives a consequence; reduces free parameters; proves a consistency condition; establishes a limiting case; connects a variable to measurement; distinguishes the model from a baseline; supplies a reproducible computation; recovers primary provenance; or creates a falsification condition. Otherwise it should normally remain a note rather than be promoted into theory structure.
